basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old recent graduate from a small town in the Midwest, currently working as a freelance graphic designer. I have a keen interest in exploring various aspects of the internet, which sometimes leads me into unexpected territories. I love gaming, especially titles like Honkai Impact 3, and have a budding interest in building custom flight sim setups. I usually browse Reddit late at night when my work quiets down, and I'm single, enjoying the flexibility it offers.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily comes from self-teaching through online resources. I graduated with a degree in digital arts, which helps in my freelance work. I'm also learning about technology and gaming peripherals through forums and DIY communities.
